title: Kenyan Grilled Salmon
community: Urban Kenya — the hotel and restaurant healthy option
author: Chef Amina Hassan
desc: Kenyan Grilled Salmon — Norwegian or Kenyan farmed salmon fillets marinated in lemon, garlic, and fresh coriander, pan-grilled to a golden crust with a blushing centre. Served with a passion fruit beurre blanc — a uniquely Kenyan flavour pairing.
longDesc: Salmon has become a staple of Kenya's hotel and restaurant menus — imported from Norway but given a Kenyan identity through its preparation. The passion fruit beurre blanc is the uniquely Kenyan contribution — its tropical acidity paired with butter and salmon is an extraordinary combination.
steps: Make beurre blanc: reduce passion fruit, wine, and shallot by two-thirds over medium heat. Remove from heat. Whisk in cold butter piece by piece until emulsified. Add honey and season.
Heat pan over high heat. Add oil.
Place salmon skin-side down. Press lightly for 30 seconds.
Cook without moving 4—5 minutes until skin is crispy and opaque halfway up the fillet.
Flip. Cook 2—3 minutes for medium (still blushing in the centre).
Rest 2 minutes. Plate and spoon beurre blanc alongside.
chefTips: Start skin-side down and do not move — the skin needs uninterrupted contact to crisp.
Beurre blanc must be made off direct heat — the cold butter should melt slowly into the reduction.
A blushing centre is the goal — overcooked salmon is dry.
commonMistakes: Moving the salmon before the skin crisps.
Beurre blanc over heat — breaks into greasy puddle.
cookingScience: The crispy salmon skin is achieved by removing all surface moisture (patting dry) before placing in a very hot pan. The Maillard reaction on the dry fish skin creates the characteristic golden, crispy surface. Beurre blanc is a warm emulsion — the cold butter pieces gradually melt and emulsify the fat into the acidic reduction.
sustainabilityTips: Choose certified sustainable salmon — look for ASC certification.
reheating: Warm gently in oven — do not microwave.
healthBenefits: Exceptionally high in omega-3 fatty acids.
Rich in B vitamins, particularly B12.
culturalNote: Grilled salmon with passion fruit beurre blanc is one of the most successful examples of Kenyan culinary fusion — a globally beloved fish made uniquely Kenyan through the extraordinary marriage with passion fruit.
